ui.maidmarriage.hug_action.hug_line:
Narration: A gentle warmth settles into your palms, and the closeness between you becomes a little softer.
Narration: The brief silence does not feel awkward at all; it only makes each breath easier to notice.
Let's stay like this a little longer... I do not need anything else right now. Being able to lean on you already feels safe enough.
If time could slow down just a little, I think I would want to remember this moment for much longer.
ui.maidmarriage.hug_action.kiss_line:
Narration: The distance closes in quietly, and even the air seems to pause for a beat.
Narration: Her eyelashes tremble slightly, and warmth begins to spread to the tips of her ears.
If we get any closer than this... I-I cannot promise I will be able to keep looking at you so calmly.
But... if it is you, maybe letting myself be a little selfish would not be so bad.
ui.maidmarriage.hug_action.pet_line:
Narration: Your fingertips pass gently through her hair, and the softness of the motion slowly reaches her.
Narration: The tension that lingered before begins to loosen bit by bit under the quiet reassurance.
Mm... just like that. You can be even gentler if you want. I really like the way you are patting my head right now.
When you comfort me this seriously, it always makes me want to move a little closer to you.
ui.maidmarriage.hug_action.idle_line_1: {player}'s shoulders... they are even broader than I imagined. Leaning on them feels very safe.
ui.maidmarriage.hug_action.idle_line_2: When {player} holds me like this, even my breathing starts to calm down... I really like this spot.
ui.maidmarriage.hug_action.idle_line_3: The warmth around {player} always makes me want to move a little closer... this feels just right.
ui.maidmarriage.hug_action.idle_line_4: So this is what it feels like in {player}'s arms... warm, and even more dependable than it looks.

guide.maidmarriage.section.0.title: Start With Keybinds
guide.maidmarriage.section.0.p.0: Open Options -> Controls -> Heart Pact and check the interaction key, pet/head-lift key, and rhythm hit key. Keybinds are changed in Minecraft controls, not on this page.
guide.maidmarriage.section.0.p.1: Opens romance interactions for adult maids, and child-maid interactions for little maids.
guide.maidmarriage.section.0.p.2: Pets a sitting maid, or lifts a standing little maid. Press it again while lifting to put her down. You can keep carrying a little maid while gliding with elytra.
guide.maidmarriage.section.0.p.3: Used during Heart Pact sleep rhythm scenes. If you do not want the rhythm game, enable skip in the rhythm settings.
guide.maidmarriage.section.0.p.4: Hide/Restore Interaction UI key: hides the interaction UI when it is open for free-view mode, and restores the panel when it is already hidden.
guide.maidmarriage.section.0.p.5: Exit Current Interaction key: exits lap pillow during lap pillow, or ends the current adult/little maid interaction. It still works while the UI is hidden.
guide.maidmarriage.section.0.p.6: In interaction screens, Esc only hides the UI and does not end the interaction. Space or Enter advances dialogue. Holding Ctrl fast-forwards with a cooldown, and fast-forwarding will not play a pile of voices at once.
guide.maidmarriage.section.0.p.7: Top-right microphone button: single-click plays the current line voice. Rapid clicks are cooled down. Double-click tries to jump to the matching line in the addon Voice Manager.
guide.maidmarriage.section.0.p.8: You can adjust lift height and hug distance in mod settings. Lift height offset defaults to 0.10 and ranges from -0.20 to 1.50. Hug lock distance defaults to 0.80 and ranges from 0.10 to 2.00.
guide.maidmarriage.section.0.p.9: The Heart Pact Guide is also the tutorial entry. Right-click to open this guide; use it on your own maid to enter the tutorial scene where she explains keys, camera, corner buttons, and common items.
guide.maidmarriage.section.1.title: Voice And AstraTTS
guide.maidmarriage.section.1.p.0: Heart Pact itself only saves voice preferences and plays already generated audio during dialogue. Batch synthesis, single-line preview, regeneration, and progress tracking are handled by the addon EasyTTSTouhouMaidAddon.
guide.maidmarriage.section.1.p.1: Step 1: install EasyTTSTouhouMaidAddon and make sure the AstraTTS service is running. The service address is usually local, such as http://127.0.0.1:port. If the addon cannot connect, check that AstraTTS is running, the firewall is not blocking it, and the address and port are correct.
guide.maidmarriage.section.1.p.2: Step 2: open Mod Settings -> Voice, enable Heart Pact Voice, and choose a voice script name. Recommended names are ja_jp, zh_cn, and en_us. Your game can be in Chinese while the voice script is ja_jp; the mod will then play generated Japanese voice files.
guide.maidmarriage.section.1.p.3: Step 3: fill in TTS names. {maid} is the maid self-reference, defaulting to メイド for Japanese. {child} is the child self-reference. {player} is the player display or narration name. {player_maid} is what the maid calls the player in her lines. {player} and {player_maid} may be the same by default, but they mean different things.
guide.maidmarriage.section.1.p.4: Step 4: open the addon page AstraTTS Config -> Heart Pact -> Voice Manager. Confirm the service address, voice, speed, maid self-reference, and script name, then click Scan. After scanning, groups appear on the left and the lines in that group appear on the right.
guide.maidmarriage.section.1.p.5: Step 5: check each line emotion. Each row shows [emotion] plus text, and clicking the text area cycles the emotion. Emotion affects reference audio and synthesis tone. If a line feels too serious, too gentle, or mismatched, adjust the emotion before generating.
guide.maidmarriage.section.1.p.6: Step 6: generate voices. Generate All creates every missing voice. Generate Group only creates the selected group. Retry Failed retries failed entries. Stop requests cancellation during generation and keeps completed audio and progress.
guide.maidmarriage.section.1.p.7: Single-line maintenance: S shows v/X for whether audio exists. T previews the current audio. R regenerates that line. If you only changed one line, one emotion, or one name, use R instead of regenerating everything.
guide.maidmarriage.section.1.p.8: In dialogue preview: single-click the top-right microphone to play the existing voice for the current line. Double-click tries to jump to the matching group and line in Voice Manager. The target line is highlighted temporarily so you can inspect or regenerate it.
guide.maidmarriage.section.1.p.9: Generated files: progress is stored in config/easyttstlm/heart_pact_voice/<script>/progress.json, and audio is stored under the same directory set. The main mod looks up audio by script name, scenario id, line id, and structured line index, so avoid manually renaming files.
guide.maidmarriage.section.1.p.10: Common case: if the UI says no pregenerated voice, confirm that the main mod and addon use the same script name. If your game language is Chinese but the script is Japanese, set the voice script to ja_jp. If lines or names changed, old audio may no longer match and should be regenerated.
guide.maidmarriage.section.1.p.11: Common case: if T preview has sound but the story has none, check the Heart Pact voice toggle and volume first. Then confirm the line was not skipped by fast-forward. Fast-forward suppresses continuous voice playback to avoid stacking many lines. TTS is currently mainly tested in the Chinese community; a more detailed guide will be published later.
guide.maidmarriage.section.2.title: Affection Stages And Unlocks
guide.maidmarriage.section.2.p.0: 0-31: initial stage. Chat, give gifts, and take care of her; intimate options are limited.
guide.maidmarriage.section.2.p.1: 32+: familiar. Head-patting becomes a stable interaction and can advance the stage.
guide.maidmarriage.section.2.p.2: 64+: closer. Hug unlocks and the relationship becomes noticeably warmer.
guide.maidmarriage.section.2.p.3: 128+: attached. Confession and dating content begin, including kissing and lover scenes.
guide.maidmarriage.section.2.p.4: 192+: commitment. Marriage threshold. Prepare rings and exchange vows through interaction.
guide.maidmarriage.section.2.p.5: If an intimate action is not shown, it is usually not broken; she is simply not ready yet.
guide.maidmarriage.section.3.title: Adult Maid Interactions
guide.maidmarriage.section.3.p.0: Talk: casual chat, weather, daily life, worries, rest, future, and more. Replies vary with mood.
guide.maidmarriage.section.3.p.1: Head pat: a light intimate action. You can also use the shortcut when she is sitting.
guide.maidmarriage.section.3.p.2: Hug: appears after 64 affection. While hugging, the right side shows actions such as kiss, keep hugging, or let go.
guide.maidmarriage.section.3.p.3: Kiss: appears after 128 affection. Kissing, over-intimacy, and rude options are affected by relationship and mood.
guide.maidmarriage.section.3.p.4: Confession: appears after reaching the dating threshold. If she accepts, you become lovers and gain the Heart Pact advancement.
guide.maidmarriage.section.3.p.5: Marriage: appears after 192 affection. Hold one proposal ring in each hand and put a ring on her during the scene.
guide.maidmarriage.section.3.p.6: Give gifts: open the gift panel and choose an item from your inventory. Up to two successful gifts per day.
guide.maidmarriage.section.4.title: Lap Pillow
guide.maidmarriage.section.4.p.0: Lap pillow unlocks after becoming lovers when her mood is normal or better. Enter it from the interaction screen.
guide.maidmarriage.section.4.p.1: Third person is hard to fit every model, but first person usually feels good. First person is recommended.
guide.maidmarriage.section.4.p.2: Maid height, pose, and head position affect the camera. If the view is blocked, click the pencil button during lap pillow and adjust FOV scale and camera height.
guide.maidmarriage.section.4.p.3: The eye-like hide button hides the interaction UI and enters free-view mode. By default, H hides/restores the UI, and Y exits the current interaction; during lap pillow, Y exits lap pillow.
guide.maidmarriage.section.4.p.4: During lap pillow you can ask for comfort, and the maid will pat your head. The action tries to support normal, GeckoLib, and YSM models.
guide.maidmarriage.section.4.p.5: Lap pillow now has daily recovery: each heal restores max(1 HP, 2% of max health), capped at 20 HP per heal. Lovers recover max(20 HP, 40% of max health) per day, capped at 200 HP, and can cleanse negative effects 3 times.
guide.maidmarriage.section.4.p.6: After marriage, daily recovery becomes max(30 HP, 60% of max health), capped at 300 HP, with 3 cleanses and 3 resistance guards. Each resistance buff lasts 50 seconds.
guide.maidmarriage.section.4.p.7: Recovery, cleansing, and resistance counts are recorded server-side. The top-right UI only shows today's status.
guide.maidmarriage.section.5.title: Kiss Camera Calibration
guide.maidmarriage.section.5.p.0: Different maid models can have different height, head bones, and camera positions. If hugs or kisses do not line up with the face, calibrate the camera in the interaction UI.
guide.maidmarriage.section.5.p.1: Open the adult maid interaction screen, enter a hug or kiss-related screen, and find the pencil button near the lower-right exit button. It opens the camera calibration panel.
guide.maidmarriage.section.5.p.2: Scale adjusts distance. Pull closer if the view is too far, or pull back if the face fills too much of the screen. The mouse wheel can temporarily adjust scale too.
guide.maidmarriage.section.5.p.3: Up/down adjusts pitch. Move up if her face is high, down if her face is low. First person is recommended while tuning.
guide.maidmarriage.section.5.p.4: Click Save when done. This is stored only on your client in config/maidmarriage/hug-camera.json and does not affect servers or other players.
guide.maidmarriage.section.6.title: What Mood Affects
guide.maidmarriage.section.6.p.0: Mood has five tiers: depressed, low, normal, happy, and Master Love. The value is roughly 0-25, with normal at 15.
guide.maidmarriage.section.6.p.1: Affection gain multipliers: depressed/low do not receive positive affection, normal x1, happy x1.5, Master Love x2.
guide.maidmarriage.section.6.p.2: Dialogue choices use current mood. Good mood improves positive feedback; bad mood makes jokes, rude choices, and excessive actions directly reduce affection.
guide.maidmarriage.section.6.p.3: Head pat, hug, kiss, gifts, and sleep interactions refresh recent interaction. Lovers or wives left alone for days may enter a patience or wanting-company state.
guide.maidmarriage.section.6.p.4: Little maid study consumes mood. If mood stays near 0 and she keeps studying, affection can drop and reward quality worsens. Exploration stops when she is too tired.
guide.maidmarriage.section.7.title: Giving Gifts
guide.maidmarriage.section.7.p.0: Gift entry is in the interaction screen under pleasing/give gift. A successful gift consumes the item. Each player can give up to two gifts per day.
guide.maidmarriage.section.7.p.1: Bouquets mainly improve closeness. Normal flowers and rainbow bouquets count as bouquets; rainbow bouquets can be given repeatedly.
guide.maidmarriage.section.7.p.2: Sweets such as cookies, cake, pumpkin pie, honey bottles, sweet berries, apples, and golden apples tend to soothe mood, especially when she feels bad.
guide.maidmarriage.section.7.p.3: Meals such as bread, milk, cooked meat, cooked fish, stew, and sauce duck steadily restore mood and may add small affection for lovers or spouses.
guide.maidmarriage.section.7.p.4: Valuables include diamonds, emeralds, gold ingots, iron ingots, amethyst, quartz, lapis, and netherite scraps. She may hesitate early on, but accepts them more easily when close.
guide.maidmarriage.section.7.p.5: Strange or offensive gifts such as rotten flesh, spider eyes, poisonous potatoes, pufferfish, and bones may lower mood or affection. Rotten flesh, fermented spider eyes, pufferfish, and poisonous potatoes are very offensive.
guide.maidmarriage.section.7.p.6: Heart Pact Guide, proposal rings, YES pillows, hairpins, debug tools, and marriage consent forms cannot be given as normal gifts.
guide.maidmarriage.section.8.title: Items And Recipes
guide.maidmarriage.section.8.p.0: Proposal Ring: diamond + iron nugget. It can be placed in the maid accessory slot. Marriage requires two rings, one in each player hand.
guide.maidmarriage.section.8.p.1: Vow Ring: created during marriage by engraving both names onto proposal rings. It is an engraved maid ring accessory, not a normal craft. A bound vow ring cannot be used to propose to someone else.
guide.maidmarriage.section.8.p.2: YES Pillow: crafted from white wool and red wool, and also given to the maid after marriage. Used for post-marriage sleep content.
guide.maidmarriage.section.8.p.3: Rainbow Bouquet: shapeless craft with oxeye daisy, poppy, cornflower, pink tulip, and dandelion. Good for gifting.
guide.maidmarriage.section.8.p.4: Golden Dandelion Hairpin: shapeless craft with clock, gold ingot, and dandelion. It is a maid accessory. Put it on a little maid to pause growth; remove it to resume growth.
guide.maidmarriage.section.8.p.5: Sauce Duck: cooked chicken surrounded by cocoa beans. Feed it to a little maid to shorten growth time, or to a postpartum maid to shorten recovery time.
guide.maidmarriage.section.8.p.6: Marriage Consent Form: book + proposal ring shapeless craft. Used to transfer guardianship of an adult child maid; see the next section.
guide.maidmarriage.section.8.p.7: Family Tree Viewer: bone meal + book shapeless craft. Right-click a maid with it to show herself, parents, grandparents, spouse, and direct children in chat.
guide.maidmarriage.section.8.p.8: Debug tools for growth, birth, pregnancy testing, pregnancy settlement, patience testing, and flower testing are mainly for testing and troubleshooting, not normal survival.
guide.maidmarriage.section.8.p.9: Contraceptive Potion: brew an Awkward Potion with a cornflower or blue orchid. It gives Safety for 5 minutes. If either the player or the maid has Safety, normal sleep, rhythm settlement, and pregnancy settlement testing will not cause pregnancy.
guide.maidmarriage.section.9.title: Family Tree And Consent Form
guide.maidmarriage.section.9.p.0: Family Tree Viewer: hold it and right-click any maid. It sends family data to chat, including self, mother, father, grandparents, spouse, and up to 8 direct children.
guide.maidmarriage.section.9.p.1: If a relative is not in the current world or the name cannot be resolved, it shows unknown or a shortened UUID. The relationship record itself is still valid.
guide.maidmarriage.section.9.p.2: Marriage Consent Form transfers guardianship of an adult child maid. It is not a direct marriage item; it lets another player raise that adult child maid again.
guide.maidmarriage.section.9.p.3: Step 1: the current owner holds the form and right-clicks an adult child maid. The form binds that maid and its tooltip shows the bound maid.
guide.maidmarriage.section.9.p.4: Step 2: keep holding the same form and right-click the target player. The target cannot be yourself and cannot be a direct blood relative within two generations of that maid.
guide.maidmarriage.section.9.p.5: After transfer: the maid belongs to the target player, marriage data is cleared, and affection resets to 0. The target must build the relationship again before confession or marriage.
guide.maidmarriage.section.9.p.6: Right-clicking another adult child maid rebinds the form and clears the old target binding, avoiding mixed records.
guide.maidmarriage.section.10.title: Marriage, Sleep, And Pregnancy
guide.maidmarriage.section.10.p.0: Before marriage, confirm she is your adult maid, affection is at least 192, inventory has room, and you hold one unbound proposal ring in each hand.
guide.maidmarriage.section.10.p.1: After marriage, the maid receives a YES Pillow. If she sleeps in a maid bed and the player is near a valid vanilla bed, sleep scenes can trigger.
guide.maidmarriage.section.10.p.2: Normal sleep pregnancy chance is not fixed: first time 20%, then +5% after each failure, up to 50%. After 8 consecutive failures, the next normal sleep guarantees pregnancy.
guide.maidmarriage.section.10.p.3: With that normal curve, pregnancy averages about 3.4 sleeps. About 58% succeed within 3 sleeps, and about 91% within 6.
guide.maidmarriage.section.10.p.4: Rhythm gameplay is calculated separately: score maps to 0%-60% pregnancy chance and does not use the normal failure guarantee. Skip or timeout counts as 0 score.
guide.maidmarriage.section.10.p.5: Pregnancy has a 2% chance for twins. When the normal sleep failure guarantee triggers, it directly treats the result as twins.
guide.maidmarriage.section.10.p.6: Pregnancy days, child growth days, and postpartum recovery are controlled by server common config. On multiplayer, check the server settings.
guide.maidmarriage.section.10.p.7: After birth, the default name is Little Maid. If she is still a baby and has not been renamed, you can name her once.
guide.maidmarriage.section.10.p.8: On the first day after birth, the baby cannot be placed on the ground. Her mother will hold her and give matching feedback.
guide.maidmarriage.section.11.title: Little Maid Interactions And Tasks
guide.maidmarriage.section.11.p.0: Little maid interactions include head pats, lifting, asking mom to hold her, talking with her, and giving her gifts.
guide.maidmarriage.section.11.p.1: Asking mom to hold her requires finding her mother. When an adult mother is holding a child, normal hug options are hidden to avoid animation conflicts.
guide.maidmarriage.section.11.p.2: During childhood, you can assign work tasks. Tasks only progress during the maid WORK schedule; sleeping, sitting, and rest time pause them.
guide.maidmarriage.section.11.p.3: Enchanting: book in main hand or backpack. Normal mood gives enchanting rewards; too tired may only produce normal books or low-tier results.
guide.maidmarriage.section.11.p.4: Alchemy: glass bottle or potion in main hand or backpack. When too tired, output may degrade to water bottles, awkward potions, or other low-quality results.
guide.maidmarriage.section.11.p.5: Tactics: weapon in main hand or backpack. Swords, axes, bows, crossbows, and tridents count. Too tired gives only low-quality combat items.
guide.maidmarriage.section.11.p.6: Exploration: stick in main hand or backpack. Higher affection lowers empty-return and injury chance, and raises reward count and rare find chance. Mood near 0 stops exploration.
guide.maidmarriage.section.13.title: Spirits, Longing, And Revival
guide.maidmarriage.section.13.p.0: If a born little maid dies, she may remain where she fell as a spirit. Spirits are not normal hostile entities; progress them through the dedicated spirit interaction screen.
guide.maidmarriage.section.13.p.1: First, soothe her. The first five soothing actions make her broken voice clearer. After that, use remembrance to help her recall home, family, and her own name.
guide.maidmarriage.section.13.p.2: Once she recognizes you, right-click her with a vanilla soul lantern to guide her. Switching your main-hand item stops following; use the soul lantern on her again to resume.
guide.maidmarriage.section.13.p.3: Bring the spirit within 10 blocks of her mother to unlock mother-related scenes. Saying goodbye or keeping the echo both require Mom to be present.
guide.maidmarriage.section.13.p.4: After choosing to keep the echo, daily soothing and offerings unlock. Daily soothing grants Longing up to 3 times per day. Offerings are also limited to 3 per day and accept only flowers or soul-related items.
guide.maidmarriage.section.13.p.5: Offering rules: a flower type offered to this spirit for the first time grants Longing +3, repeated flowers grant +1, and soul-touched items grant +2. First-time flowers are tracked separately per spirit.
guide.maidmarriage.section.13.p.6: At Longing 100, her outline becomes clearer and a new spirit dialogue option appears. After that scene, using a Totem of Undying on her may bring her back to your side.
guide.maidmarriage.section.13.p.7: If you say goodbye, she leaves a letter and Mom's child-loss grief is cleared. If you keep the echo, this version no longer routes to goodbye; continue soothing, offering, and preparing for revival.
guide.maidmarriage.section.13.p.8: If Longing has not reached 100 yet, keep talking to her, soothe her, or offer suitable flowers and soul-related items within the daily limits. Progress is tracked separately for each spirit. In this version, little maid spirits using GeckoLib or YSM models fall back to the Touhou model.
guide.maidmarriage.section.12.title: FAQ
guide.maidmarriage.section.12.p.0: Options do not show: check affection threshold, ownership, whether the target is adult or little maid, sitting/sleeping state, and harem mode restrictions.
guide.maidmarriage.section.12.p.1: Marriage cannot continue: check that both rings are unbound proposal rings. Bound rings are blocked.
guide.maidmarriage.section.12.p.2: Little maid task does not start: she needs usable backpack space, must be on WORK schedule, cannot be sitting or sleeping, and materials must be in main hand or backpack.
guide.maidmarriage.section.12.p.3: Gift has no response: each day allows up to two successful gifts, and some special items cannot be given. Inventory slots and held item changes follow server sync.
guide.maidmarriage.section.12.p.4: Server and singleplayer differ: pregnancy days, growth days, and postpartum recovery use server common config. Pregnancy chance follows this guide's fixed curve. Harem mode is a local setting synced to the server.
guide.maidmarriage.section.12.p.5: Debug buttons and countdowns: F7/F8, countdowns, and UI action hints on the debug page are only for testing or troubleshooting and can be disabled for normal play.

dialogue.maidmarriage.lap_pillow.start.0: She gently pats her lap. Her ears turn a little red, but she still looks at you seriously. "If you are tired... you can rest here for a while."
dialogue.maidmarriage.lap_pillow.start.1: As soon as you lower yourself down, she carefully supports your shoulder, as if afraid you might bump into something. Even her voice becomes softer.
dialogue.maidmarriage.lap_pillow.start.2: She smooths her skirt and looks down at you, her gaze as soft as afternoon light. "Only for a little while, okay? Do not sleep too long."
dialogue.maidmarriage.lap_pillow.start.3: When you lean onto her lap, her fingers pause in midair. After a small hesitation, they gently settle in your hair.
dialogue.maidmarriage.lap_pillow.start.4: She lets you rest on her lap. When she lowers her head to look at you, even her breathing feels careful, as if she might disturb the quiet.
She gently avoids your gaze. "Not today... I think I want you to comfort me first."
She places a hand over her chest, her voice a little low. "It is not that I dislike you. My heart just feels a bit unsettled today."
She presses her lips together. "When I feel a little better, I will let you come closer, okay?"
She is not angry. She only shakes her head gently. Right now, more than a lap pillow, she seems to want you to stay and talk with her slowly.
dialogue.maidmarriage.lap_pillow.pet.0:
Maid: "What is it? Are you tired today? Then do not push yourself."
Narration: She bends down, her palm slowly resting on your head, gently stroking your hair again and again.
dialogue.maidmarriage.lap_pillow.pet.1:
Maid: "There, there... I am right here."
Narration: Her fingertips glide softly across your forehead. The motion is slow, as if she is afraid to disturb this small moment of peace.
dialogue.maidmarriage.lap_pillow.pet.2:
Maid: "You can rely on me once in a while too."
Narration: She looks a little shy, but still leans down earnestly and gently rubs the top of your head.
dialogue.maidmarriage.lap_pillow.pet.3:
Maid: "You have done more than enough. Rest for a little while today."
Narration: Her hand lingers beside your head, soothing you several times with a tenderness that softens her voice too.
dialogue.maidmarriage.lap_pillow.pet.4:
Maid: "You usually take care of me. Today, let me comfort you instead."
Narration: She slowly reaches out and pats your head, awkward but sincere, as if hiding all her concern in her palm.
dialogue.maidmarriage.lap_pillow.exit.0: She helps you sit up slowly, her hand still resting on your shoulder, as if she is a little reluctant to let this quiet moment end.
dialogue.maidmarriage.lap_pillow.exit.1: When you rise, she instinctively tugs at you, then quickly lets go and looks away with a blush.
dialogue.maidmarriage.lap_pillow.exit.2: "Did you rest well?" she asks softly, the tenderness from a moment ago still in her eyes.
dialogue.maidmarriage.lap_pillow.exit.3: She straightens the edge of your clothes as if nothing happened, but the corners of her mouth quietly lift.

item.maidmarriage.spirit_farewell_letter:
Dad,
If you are reading this letter, I must have already gone somewhere far away. Please do not keep blaming yourself. I did not come to this home so you would learn loss. I came here because I was truly loved.
I will remember Mom's arms, and the sound of you calling my name. Please live well for me too. Even if remembering me hurts, walk toward tomorrow after the tears. Goodbye, Dad.
Soothe the little maid spirit for the first time.
